sermon.title: The Gospel as a Witness
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this session on present truths Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that the gospel of the kingdom and of repentance and remission of sins will be preached to all nations as a witness, confirmed by signs and wonders. He walks through the signs that follow believers, the signs of an apostle and the results in Acts, and says a last-days visitation greater than the early church is coming, with the ministries of apostle and prophet restored.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor note: the captions give the Issachar reference as “1 Chronicles 12:38”; the verse about the children of Issachar is 1 Chronicles 12:32 (shown below). He corrects himself on “Haggai 2:17, I mean 2:7” and “Second Chronicles, I mean Corinthians 12:12.” His naming of well-known preachers and church leaders, his statements about over a million Jews slaughtered in AD 70, and his history of Azusa Street (1906) and of all nations being discovered after 1500 AD are his own and are not verified here. One name in the list of preachers is marked [unclear], along with several other words.

chunks.section_question: What message will usher in the end time? (Matthew 24:14; Luke 24:47)
chunks.short_answer: He says the gospel of the kingdom shall be preached to all nations “as a witness,” and Jesus said repentance and remission of sins should be preached in His name to all nations. He says that message, not prosperity, the second coming, positive thinking, personal prophecy or poverty, is what will usher in the end time.

faqs.question: What does the word “shall” mean in Matthew 24:14?
faqs.answer: He says the word shall means nothing can prevent it from happening: the gospel shall be preached to all nations.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in all the world as a witness to all the nations, and then the end will come.

faqs.question: What distracts the church from the message that ushers in the end time?
faqs.answer: He says we get distracted with prosperity, the second coming, possibility and positive thinking, personal prophecy and poverty, none of which will usher in the end.

faqs.question: Do you have to be baptized to be saved?
faqs.answer: He says “repenting and being baptized is imperative in the Bible for salvation,” and Mark 16:16 doesn’t repeat baptism because unbelievers won’t be baptized anyway.

scriptures.text_nkjv: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who does not believe will be condemned.

faqs.question: Is speaking in tongues an earthly language?
faqs.answer: He says on the day of Pentecost people heard them speak in their own languages, and the outpouring of the Holy Spirit was “not just a heavenly tongue but an earthly language.”

faqs.question: Do you have to be filled with the Holy Ghost to do great things?
faqs.answer: He says the twelve had power to cast out evil spirits before they were filled with the Holy Ghost, so “God can give you power period.”

faqs.question: What does the word apostle mean?
faqs.answer: He says the definition of apostle is a messenger or one sent, and we are all sent to preach the gospel, but an apostle can be told by signs and wonders.

faqs.question: Were the miracles of Pharaoh’s magicians real?
faqs.answer: He says the magicians did lying wonders, not real miracles, and could only do what God allowed; after the lice came they couldn’t do anymore.

faqs.question: What kind of word did John the Baptist preach?
faqs.answer: He says John the Baptist did no miracles, but his word was a rhema word, a living word, and it brought people to salvation.

faqs.question: Should Christians be focused on a temple being built in Jerusalem?
faqs.answer: He says don’t get wrapped up in a temple being built over there in Jerusalem; human beings are the real temple of God, and the Spirit of God dwells in you.

scriptures.text_nkjv: And what agreement has the temple of God with idols? For you are the temple of the living God. As God has said: “I will dwell in them And walk among them. I will be their God, And they shall be My people.”

faqs.question: What does he say about the price of rejecting God?
faqs.answer: He says the Jews were disobedient for hundreds of years and paid the price, and “don’t think you’re going to get away with stubbornly rejecting the things of God.”

faqs.question: Are most people who think they have a demon really possessed?
faqs.answer: He says he has cast out a few demons, but most he encountered were not demons at all, just people thinking they had one who had to be taught through the Bible.
